source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 13 measured values (11 from the ThermoML Archive), the normal boiling temperature 510.70 K (Weast and Grasselli, 1989 (normal boiling temperature, NIST WebBook), fitted as 101.325 kPa, never left out) and the critical point, 298.20-692.00 K, max deviation 5.3 %, each within its own stated uncertainty. Between 510.70 K and the critical point the curve is held only by the critical point.
